offertory collection: mission sunday month of october rosary: the rosary will be recited each evening at 8.00pm, queen of peace church for the month of october. all welcome. first holy communion or confirmation in 2027 : parents who wish to enrol their child for first holy communion or confirmation in 2027 may now do so. our catholic primary schools have already circulated letters of information to relevant families, but if your child is home-schooled or attending a non-catholic school enrolling for a sacrament may be done through the fermoy parish website, under the heading of sacraments. the annual november remembrance mass: the annual remembrance mass this november for those who have died in the parish will be celebrated on friday 6th november in st patrick’s church at 7.30pm. families are invited to come along and remember their loved ones who have gone to their eternal reward. as in prior years, we will remember in a special way all those within the parish who died in the past 12 months, a representative of their families will be invited to this remembrance mass. if any family have any relatives who died in the past 12 months that lived in fermoy & you wish to have them included at this mass, please contact the parish office by friday 23rd oct. thank you fermoy musical society presents hello, dolly! from november 7-14th in the palace theatre, fermoy. tickets available on

fermoy active retirement; next group meeting will be held on wednesday the 21st of october at 2.30pm in fermoy community youth centre. paula murphy, public participation network will be our guest speaker. all members most welcome. children's liturgy : we will be celebrating 25 years of children's liturgy at the 10.30 am mass on sunday 8th of november. we hope to see lots of children and their families on the day. light refreshments will be provided after mass in the wagon tavern. we would also like to extend an invitation to all past leaders, who were involved at any time over the last 25 years, to join us in our celebrations. anniversary list: peggy coughlan, 6th anniv. lisnasallagh; john murphy anniv. corrin view; deceased members of the mulligan family; jim & eily ahern, anniv. clancy street; denis & carmel fanning, anniv. castlehyde; richard & abina browne, anniv. macroom; donol moloney, 13th anniv. bellview, sean o'brien, 20th anniv, mary potter crescent. remembering his family & his sister teresa who died recently; margaret collins, anniv. cork; andrea kovacova and ludovit pasztorova; tadg hogan, de valera drive, beechfield estate; michael condon, 17th anniv. duntahane; mary walsh, 4th anniv. 4 cork road; micheal o'grady, kent street & france;

nuala fitz gibbon, mccurtain street; patricia linehan (nee hilliard) who died recently, late of wolfe tone pk & redmond st, sister of harriet cotter; sr. nuala reidy , kilkenny city & formally loretto convent, fermoy girls' get together organised by the servant sisters: on saturday oct 24th. for girls in 2nd-6th class (ages 8-12). from 12:30 - 5:30pm. in the adair hall, oliver plunkett hill, fermoy, co. cork p61 dd73 (across from fermoy town park). please make sure you let us know if your daughter would like to attend. when you sign up, we will send on the consent form. one consent form covers the whole school year. sign up soon!

18th october 2026 ~ 29th sunday in ordinary time - mission sunday reflection for the 29th week (fr. micah kemboi, .) faithful steward: do not be afraid (luke 12:39-48) peace be with you. this week, we focus on our call to faithful stewa rdship, following the example of the saints and paying special attention to st. john paul who we cele brate on 22nd october 2026. during st. john paul ii’s papacy, the church was wounded after vatican they outh were leaving the church, and the world was divided by communism and war. on his part, pope john paul was not afraid; he endured pain and suffering, including an assassination attempt by mehmet ali agca, whom he later forgave. we ask for his intercession as we celebrate him, especially for the divine mercy chaplet he introduced and the luminous mysteries of the holy rosary. our holy father, pope leo xiv, is also a leading example of why we should not be afraid. in the recent past, the pope has endured a lot of attacks and backlash orchestrated by president donald trump and his administration. on his part, the pope responded a s follows: “i have no fear of the trump administration nor of speaking out loudly about the message of the gospel…we’re not politicians. we’re not looking to make foreign policy… message of gospel, blessed are the peace makers.” dear christians, as we enter this new week, let us pray for the speedy recovery of our pope after successful surgery hence another reason why we should not be afraid. let us remain steadfast in our faith as faithful stewards in our families and as individu als and above all, don’t be afraid. st. john paul pray for us. amen. cemetery prayers in november st. gobnait’s ;
